label: glucose
definition: A monosaccharide sugar with formula C6H12O6.

label: beta-D-glucose
definition: The beta-anomer of D-glucose.

label: alpha-D-glucose
definition: The alpha-anomer of D-glucose.

label: fructose
definition: A ketohexose sugar found in fruit.

label: sucrose
definition: A disaccharide of glucose and fructose.

label: lactose
definition: A disaccharide found in milk.

label: maltose
definition: A disaccharide of two glucose units.

label: trehalose
definition: A disaccharide of two alpha-glucose units.

label: salicin
definition: A glucoside found in willow bark.

label: carbohydrate
definition: A generic class of sugars and their derivatives.

label: ribose
definition: An aldopentose sugar central to RNA.

label: sorbitol
definition: A sugar alcohol derived from glucose.

label: xylitol
definition: A five-carbon sugar alcohol used as a sweetener.

label: ribitol
definition: A five-carbon sugar alcohol.

label: mannitol
definition: A six-carbon sugar alcohol.

label: palmitic acid
definition: A saturated 16-carbon fatty acid.

label: oleic acid
definition: A monounsaturated 18-carbon fatty acid.

label: linoleic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated omega-6 fatty acid.

label: alpha-linolenic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated omega-3 fatty acid.

label: stearic acid
definition: A saturated 18-carbon fatty acid.

label: water
definition: The oxide of hydrogen.

label: ethanol
definition: A primary alcohol found in alcoholic beverages.

label: methanol
definition: The simplest aliphatic alcohol.

label: propan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol used as a solvent.

label: acetate
definition: The conjugate base of acetic acid.

label: acetic acid
definition: A two-carbon carboxylic acid.

label: lactate
definition: The conjugate base of lactic acid.

label: lactic acid
definition: A three-carbon hydroxy acid.

label: citric acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid found in citrus fruit.

label: citrate
definition: The conjugate base of citric acid.

label: arachidonic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated omega-6 fatty acid precursor to eicosanoids.

label: caffeine
definition: A methylxanthine stimulant found in coffee and tea.

label: theobromine
definition: A methylxanthine found in cocoa.

label: theophylline
definition: A methylxanthine used as a bronchodilator.

label: acetylsalicylic acid
definition: A salicylate used as an analgesic and antipyretic.

label: salicylic acid
definition: A beta hydroxy acid and aspirin precursor.

label: paracetamol
definition: An analgesic and antipyretic.

label: ibuprofen
definition: A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug.

label: creatinine
definition: A breakdown product of creatine phosphate in muscle.

label: creatine
definition: A nitrogenous organic acid found in muscle tissue.

label: galactose
definition: An aldohexose sugar and component of lactose.

label: cholesterol
definition: A sterol found in animal cell membranes.

label: cortisol
definition: A glucocorticoid steroid hormone.

label: testosterone
definition: An androgenic steroid hormone.

label: estradiol
definition: The principal oestrogen in humans.

label: choline
definition: An essential nutrient and precursor to acetylcholine.

label: acetylcholine
definition: A neurotransmitter at the neuromuscular junction.

label: dopamine
definition: A catecholamine neurotransmitter.

label: serotonin
definition: A monoamine neurotransmitter.

label: noradrenaline
definition: A catecholamine neurotransmitter and hormone.

label: ascorbic acid
definition: A water-soluble vitamin and antioxidant.

label: cholecalciferol
definition: A form of vitamin D produced in skin.
